Overview

The next 010 Rapid Open is here! This time at the Delfshaven library and just like the Central Library, it's easily accessible by car (and just a 7-minute walk from the metro station). We've got prizes ready for the top 3 players, so you better be there! (note: If the player count reaches 20 players, we'll use the swiss pairing system. Otherwise, we'll use the round robin pairing system)
